title: "Pay full price": the things you'd gladly never haggle on
summary: Lip-sync to the excited "pay full price" sound with on-screen text about the one thing you'd pay full price for, no deal needed. AI writes the lines.
why: Virlo's trend page, updated November 22, 2026, lists "He wanna pay full price" as a fresh TikTok format first seen November 8, with about 513 creators in the last 7 days. People lip-sync to an excited audio line from a recent sketch-comedy clip and add on-screen text about a relatable situation. It lands in Black Friday week, so it's a fun flip on all the sale posts.
steps: Find the trending "pay full price" sound in your app.
Paste the main prompt into a chat tool and pick the caption that feels most like you.
Film yourself lip-syncing the line with big, happy energy. Put the caption on screen before the line hits.
Post it. Keep the topic light and about you.

prompts.label: Main prompt: your full-price moments
prompts.text: There's a TikTok trend where people lip-sync an excited "he wanna pay full price" line, with on-screen text about something they happily pay full price for. Write 10 on-screen captions for me. Each should start with "Me when" or "POV:" and be under 12 words. Make them warm and a bit silly, about everyday things like good coffee, a friend's homemade baking, a kid's lemonade stand or warm winter boots. Things I'm into: [list a few]. Nothing about money problems, debt or other people's private lives.

prompts.label: Variation: the Canadian winter edition
prompts.text: Write 8 short on-screen captions for the "pay full price" lip-sync trend, all about Canadian winter. Ideas like snow tires, a real winter coat, the good hot chocolate at the rink or a snow-clearing service on a bad morning. Under 12 words each, starting with "Me when" or "POV:". Make them funny and relatable, with Canadian spelling.

prompts.label: Variation: the gift-giver
prompts.text: Write 8 captions for the "pay full price" lip-sync trend about buying gifts for people I love. The joke is that I'd skip the sale because the gift is perfect. Under 12 words each, kind and funny, no brand names. People I'm shopping for: [mom, best friend, my dog, etc.].

prompts.label: Variation for a small business: why our regulars don't wait for sales
prompts.text: I run [type of business] in [town]. Write 6 on-screen captions for the "pay full price" lip-sync trend from a happy customer's point of view, about what makes our work worth it: [list real things, like handmade, local, same-day repairs, friendly service]. Under 12 words each. Keep it honest: no fake urgency, no made-up reviews, no claims about prices or other shops.

tips: Put the caption up a beat before the line so viewers read it first.
Big, happy energy is the whole joke. Overdo the grin.
Skip topics about debt, support payments or anyone's private money. Keep it about small joys.
Businesses: film a real regular only if they agree, or say the line yourself.
